words.definition: Existing or occurring among or between the stars.

words.definition: A natural or artificial body that orbits a larger body in space, such as a moon orbiting a planet or a man-made object used for communication, navigation, or observation.

words.example_sk: Vedci vypustili nový satelit, aby skúmal atmosféru Zeme.

words.definition: A range or band of related values, qualities, or ideas; specifically, the continuous sequence of colors produced when light is dispersed, or the distribution of electromagnetic radiation by wavelength or frequency.

words.definition: A large spacecraft designed for travel between stars, especially as depicted in science fiction.

words.definition: The point in the sky directly above an observer; the highest point or culmination.
words.example_en: At noon the sun reached its zenith.
words.example_sk: O poludní slnko dosiahlo svoj zenit.

words.definition: Either of the two times each year when the sun crosses the celestial equator and day and night are approximately equal in length.
words.example_en: The spring equinox marks the beginning of astronomical spring.
words.example_sk: Jarná rovnodennosť označuje začiatok astronomického jara.

words.definition: Either of the two times in the year when the sun is at its greatest distance from the celestial equator, causing the longest day (summer solstice) or the shortest day (winter solstice).
words.example_en: We celebrated the summer solstice with a bonfire on the beach.
words.example_sk: Letný slnovrat sme oslávili ohňom na pláži.
